item.text: {"summary":"The failure is in CEscapeInternal: after emitting a hexadecimal escape, its condition escapes the next byte when that byte is not a hex digit. A following hex digit therefore remains adjacent and is consumed as part of the preceding escape by CUnescapeInternal. The supplied implementation and failure evidence are sufficient to identify the repair location and behavior.","hypotheses":["CEscapeInternal’s inverted hex-digit check leaves a following ASCII hex digit unescaped, so CUnescapeInternal consumes it as part of the preceding hexadecimal escape."],"queries":[],"reads":[],"ready":true}
